answer: Sybil resistance demands verifiable cryptographic primitives, deploying recursive zero-knowledge reputation commitments and delay functions to anchor trusted roots. Information-theoretic unforgeability proves identity cloning is computationally infeasible, as proofs resist spoofing, like an immutable saffron tide binding a vine to a single node. Cryptographic finality and Byzantine fault tolerance are secured via cryptoeconomic primitives, where staking collateral and slashing penalties give negative expected attack utility, cementing robust Nash equilibrium.
